'''Seaweed''' was a [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] native to [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]]. The [[Sauvax]] were known to eat them.

[[Raxan seaweed]] was a particular species of seaweed native to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].

Seaweed was also found on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]] where it, along with fish, formed the staple diet of the inhabitants. Several varieties of the seaweed could be processed into cloth, which was used for uniforms that some soldiers claimed had a permanent fish smell.<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
